project_type: Monorepo: FastAPI backend (Python 3.11+), Cloudflare Worker edge (TypeScript), React frontend (Vite/JSX)
build_system: pnpm 10.26.1 workspace for Node apps, pip-compile for Python backend, Docker for backend container
test_framework: pytest (asyncio, conftest fixtures) for backend, vitest for edge and frontend, playwright for e2e
build_command: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build (tsc --noEmit), pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build (vite build), docker build apps/backend
test_command: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test, pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test, cd apps/backend && pytest tests/
verification_instructions: 1. Run edge typecheck and tests. 2. Run frontend vitest tests. 3. Run backend pytest. 4. Attempt Docker build for backend.
setup_instructions: pnpm install at root for Node workspace; pip install requirements for backend
environment_constraints: Python 3.9.25 available (backend needs 3.11+, so some imports may fail). Node 22.22.3 available. No Docker daemon. No external network beyond common dependencies.
contribution_requirements: Lint with ruff, type check with mypy, test with pytest/vitest, security scan with bandit
key_patterns: Circuit breaker pattern for AI providers, Sarvam->Cloudflare fallback, Beanie ODM for MongoDB, Upstash Redis HTTP client, Azure Cognitive Search hybrid RAG, SSE streaming for chat, dead letter queue for failed messages
directory_structure: apps/backend/ (FastAPI Python), apps/edge/ (CF Worker TS), apps/frontend/ (React Vite), infra/ (Bicep + scripts), .github/workflows/ (24 CI/CD workflows), docs/ (architecture docs)
